_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Ou se Jwè {player_id} nan yon jwèt Dez Menteur {num_players}-jwè.
Reglemàn:
- Nan toun ou, ou ka chwazi ant:
  1) Fe yon nouvo ofè ak yon kantite pi wo oswa yon figi pi wo (oswa tou de) pase ofè aktyèl la; egzanp '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Rele dènye ofè a pa tape '[Call]'.

Si ou rele:
  - Si kont kwèl nan valè figi sa a nan tout dez yo mwens ke ofè a, dènye moun ki te fe ofè a pèdi yon dez.
  - Si non, moun ki te rele a pèdi yon dez.
Yon jwè ki rive 0 dez elimine. Dènye jwè ki rete genyen.

board.new_round:
Nouvèl tour - Dez avèk {dice_summary} mache.
Dez aktyèl ou ye: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Jwè {current_player_id} rele! Kont kwèl nan figi {face_value} se {count}, ki mwens ke {quantity}.
Jwè {loser_id} (dènye moun ki te fe ofè a) pèdi yon dez.
call.caller_loses:
Jwè {current_player_id} rele! Kont kwèl nan figi {face_value} se {count}, ki >= {quantity}.
Jwè {loser_id} (moun ki te rele) pèdi yon dez.

action.bid_announce: Jwè {player_id} fe yon ofè {quantity} nan figi {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Rele te fè san okenn òf anvan.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Aksyon pa rekonèt kom yon '[Bid: X, Y]' valab oswa '[Call]'. Aksyon soumèt: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Nouvo kantite {new_quantity} se pi ba pase aktyèl la {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nouvo valè nominal {new_face_value} pi ba pase aktyèl la {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Bid se idantik ak bid aktyèl la.

message.eliminated_invalid: Jwè {player_id} te elimine pa mouvman envalid.
